def: a support (concretely), i.e. (figuratively) a protector or sustenance

occurrences.text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.
For, behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
